EXECUTIVE.label: Executive Reports
EXECUTIVE.description: Formal management reporting across your authorised scope, with coverage and freshness. No composite executive score is invented.

PORTFOLIO.label: Portfolio Reports
PORTFOLIO.description: The projects in your portfolio scope, with the safeguards that keep unlike figures apart.

DEPARTMENT.label: Department Reports
DEPARTMENT.description: Reports over the projects of the departments you may see.

PROJECT.label: Project Reports
PROJECT.description: Formal project reports and project-domain reports for the projects you may see.

FINANCIAL.label: Financial Reports
FINANCIAL.description: Financial and KPI reporting. Sensitive amounts are shown only to those allowed to see them, and masked otherwise.

PROGRESS.label: Progress Reports
PROGRESS.description: Progress reporting status and published progress history.

RISK_ISSUE.label: Risk & Issue Reports
RISK_ISSUE.description: Risks, issues and challenges as their workflows recorded them; nothing is rescored.

issues.VALUE_INVALID: the value is no longer valid
